function: Excluded for function: the learned CSIformer counts and localizes moving targets from CSI (p. 6), i.e. sensing and localization; no beam, waveform, or resource design (p. 2).
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. The transformer-based CSIformer classifies the number of targets and their section from CSI estimated at the communication receiver (p. 6): opportunistic sensing and localization, an excluded function. Area 5 does not apply: with communication-centric signals "it is not possible to optimize or adapt the waveform design, beamforming, or power allocation" (p. 2). The paper calls itself an ISAC framework (p. 3), which the reviewer may weigh. If overturned: code link on p. 1, QuaDRiGa and NIST Q-D ray tracing on p. 7.
